verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs describe isolated Pods/Serverless with containerized multi-tenant isolation (runpod-docs-57) and separate network volumes, but there is no documented sandbox/staging mode or explicit guarantee of separating test workloads from a user's production Pods/data. Missing for 10: explicit staging/sandbox environment feature, documented separation of test vs production data, and any first-party or community confirmation that testing on Runpod cannot touch production resources.
